observations.statement: Even theta proposition starts with actual nonzero reference L value and fixed local filter. Waldspurger global packet and positive real frequency supply nonzero holomorphic unary-orthogonal member, rather than merely a formal coefficient relation.

Local scalar type is constructed using additive projection, normalized Weil unit action and a matching two-power parity character. Explicit two-neighborhood calculation at2 prevents cancellation. Smooth lower invariance gives K0 type; global rational central action gives required psi parity.

Squareclass projector retains reference and scalar type; unramified coefficient is1 at squarefree valuations0,1. Full-space Waldspurger identity uses same dyadic squareclass to avoid H2 and yields proportional functionals by polynomial-domain argument, not multiplicity one.

Algebraic model uses flat field extension and finite-dimensional linear conditions. Unary exclusion needs chosen common-good operator and adjoint stability plus eigenvalue separation, not a stronger unsupported all-level assertion. No arbitrary-residue base-change theorem.

Galois and finite-character twist comparison pass to common level with same support; full-space proportionality and nonzero reference give exact phase. Local square roots construct z_D and all automorphisms fix a(D)/z_D, proving rationality without assuming L-ratio rationality.

Later zero-retain sieve is applied after squarefree identity and cannot reset the minimum. Good-prime recurrence propagates rational root-of-unity phases to square shells; lower valuation bound and retained reference make minimum attained.

Odd conductor-one point is distinct from conductor-|h| ring-class point. Selmer parity and BFH choose fixed negative nonzero and positive simple-zero witnesses before precision. Genus character field and CST unaveraged height with split level/no extra units supply nontorsion.

Two fixed good primes bound torsion over degree<=4 fields. Integral4e_D projection and cusp annihilator give one L placing every genus sum in D-twist rational line, including D=1; no claim original P_D is K_D-rational.

Non-CM open image and Kummer injection force open translation image; finite-index auxiliary intersection preserves it without disjointness. Actual h tau gives one fixed valuation. Chebotarev at each precision and finite-field Kummer evaluation give same visible witness and Frobenius sign; arbitrary new field prescriptions need compatibility.

Odd theta begins from actual stage and same lambda/L. Finite-field evaluation is choice-independent because Frobenius fixes2^M torsion; kernel and cardinality give quotient isomorphism. This records exact convention rather than normalizing an unspecified functional.

Ribet right-Hom convention identifies enhanced supersingular ideal classes, automorphisms and uniformizer Frobenius. Coarse points are quadratic-field rational. Good-locus Hecke specialization uses based quotient identity; Atkin cusp translations require L, and lambda gives uniformizer+1.

Finite Schwartz inputs specify supports and actual cyclic level root. Odd integral projectors and dyadic e_x projectors give locally constant selected root and character parity; no division by2 at dyadic projector stage. Ramified m support uses nilpotent conjugacy and square-determinant centralizer for well-defined sign.
